headline: Bortoleto retires from Singapore Grand Prix with suspected gearbox trouble
body: Bortoleto stopped near the pit exit with a suspected gearbox issue, triggering a Virtual Safety Car. Audi will investigate the cause after the race.

headline: Colapinto retires from Singapore Grand Prix with suspected driveline trouble
body: Colapinto stopped on track before moving his Alpine into a run-off area to retire. Alpine suspects a driveline issue and will investigate when the car is recovered.

headline: Stroll retires from the Singapore Grand Prix
body: Stroll locked up, ran off and parked his Aston Martin at Turn 15. His retirement brought out a Virtual Safety Car.

headline: Piastri makes an extra Singapore pit stop after a puncture
body: Piastri reported a front-right puncture and made an extra pit stop. He rejoined in sixth, further behind the fight for fourth and fifth.
